name: prompt-protocol-monorepo
description: PROMPT Protocol Extension - Validate AI-generated code against PROMPT rules
author: PROMPT Protocol Team

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/prompt-validator && npm run build --prefix packages/vscode-extension
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/shared && npm run test --prefix packages/prompt-validator
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix packages/shared && npm run lint --prefix packages/prompt-validator && npm run lint --prefix packages/vscode-extension
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/shared && npm install && cd ../prompt-validator && npm install && cd ../vscode-extension && npm install
